The ceiling is the LAST row. It goes up only through node tests/edge-bundle.mjs --raise "<why>", which appends a row with its reason;
node tests/edge-bundle.mjs --write appends a lower row after a cut (a cut of more than 4 KB is red until it is locked in).
Written by the tool, never by hand. Two lanes that both moved a ceiling conflict here: take either side and run the tool again.
